tools.name: premises_plugin_info
tools.description: Explain the read-only UK Premises Licence Navigator scope.

tools.name: list_supported_authorities
tools.description: List local licensing authorities currently supported by the premises-licensing decision service.

tools.name: authority_support_check
tools.description: Check whether one named local licensing authority is supported. Does not make a licensing decision.

tools.name: premises_preflight_input_guide
tools.description: Show the categories of facts to prepare before a premises-licensing preflight. Use only user-supplied facts; never infer or default missing authority, venue, activity, alcohol, hours, or exemption facts.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_supported_authorities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free authority-enumeration tool. Use only to list supported local licensing authorities or answer whether a named authority is supported. Do not use it to make the licensing decision." → after: "List local licensing authorities currently supported by the premises-licensing decision service."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
